text:
sam (AE): Heads-up: Mike at Meridian Capital sent the completed SIG this morning. They flagged ~95 questions they need evidence for. Can we do a quick triage and split work?

jordan (SE): I can take auth, SSO, and session management Qs. Do we have the current IdP metadata and assertion examples?

nina (security): I'll take cryptography, key lifecycle, incident response, and logging controls. @jordan please share any SAML/OIDC artifacts you pull.

liam (sales-engineer): I'll own network controls, peering, and monitoring. Also will prepare the vendor subprocessor list. Is there a canonical vendor CSV?

sam (AE): We have last year's vendor CSV but it's stale. Artifact-bot, can you fetch the latest?

artifact-bot: Retrieved file meridian-vendors-2025.csv (redacted) from s3://evidence/meridian/ -- presigned link expires in 72h.

jordan (SE): Downloaded. I see entries for Auth0 (legacy) and internal IdP. I'll export SAML metadata and a couple of signed assertion samples.

nina (security): For encryption questions please include: KMS provider, rotation cadence, HSM usage (yes/no), and sample KMS policy. Also include last key rotation timestamps.

liam (sales-engineer): I'll add a short diagram showing control plane vs data plane and a note about no customer data stored in EU for this tenant (per Mike's tenancy). Need exact phrasing for legal.

mike (customer): Confirmed: production data is in us-west-2 only for our deployment. Logs may be replicated to us-east-1 for backups only. Legal wants explicit statements + retention windows.

ellen (procurement): Also request: can you provide a signed SOC2 addendum and a point person for security contact? They need an onboarding contact for procurement.

sam (AE): I'll attach SOC2 and provide a named security contact. Nina, want to be the named security contact?

nina (security): I can be the contact for technical questions. I'll handle inbound questions from Meridian's security team next Wednesday.

jordan (SE): Quick note on Question 22/23 about session fixation: our platform issues rotated session tokens every 15 minutes and uses anti-CSRF tokens for browser flows. I'll paste a short code snippet and link to our auth doc.

liam (sales-engineer): For network controls I'll add the NACL and SG examples and an excerpt of the VPC peering policy. Also upload RTO/RPO for backups.

artifact-bot: New upload: meridian-sig-evidence-packet-176912.zip (1.8MB) to s3://evidence/meridian/ -- md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e.

sam (AE): We're short on time. Proposal: split the SIG into buckets (Auth, Encryption, Network, DR, Compliance docs). Each owner marks question IDs they cover in the SIG tracker and drops artifacts into /meridian/ by EOD tomorrow.

nina (security): Agreed. I'll mark crypto and incident response QIDs and upload redacted timelines for last two incidents. Reminder: redact account IDs and IPs.

jordan (SE): Added a sheet 'QID-owners' in the tracker and assigned Qs 1-30 to me.

liam (sales-engineer): Assigned network Qs 31-60 to me. I'll upload diagrams and a short note about egress filtering.

sam (AE): Mike asked whether we can provide signed attestations for specific questions (they prefer a signature on certain answers). Legal says we can provide attestations where backed by SOC2 or documented policy. I'll flag which answers can be signed.

ellen (procurement): If you can mark the signable items in the tracker that speeds procurement.

mike (customer): Appreciate the clarity. Also: Meridian requests a CAIQ mapping in addition to SIG answers. Do we have a pre-filled CAIQ template?

nina (security): We have a CAIQ mapping from last quarter. I'll refresh it and attach. It will be a separate file: meridian-CAIQ-map-2026.xlsx.

sam (AE): Great. Final request for this thread: include a README that lists every uploaded file, the redaction notes, and contact names. Artifact-bot, can you auto-generate a manifest?

artifact-bot: Manifest generated: manifest-meridian-1769129999.txt (references 14 files).

sam (AE): Thanks team. I'll reply to Meridian with ETA: full packet by 48 hours, contact: nina@redwood.com for security questions, jordan for auth.

mike (customer): Sounds good. If you can also note retention windows for logs and backups explicitly that helps legal.

liam (sales-engineer): Will include a table: logs retention = 90 days, backups snapshot retention = 30 days (encrypted at rest).

nina (security): One last quick reminder: include cryptographic algorithms used (AES-256-GCM, RSA-2048 for signing) in the KMS doc.

jordan (SE): I'll paste the SAML metadata and a very short example assertion in the artifacts folder.

sam (AE): Closing: everyone drop files into s3://evidence/meridian/ and update the tracker. We'll reconvene if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
